Combine human and lightning caused acres by geographic area and year; clean numeric columns (remove commas), convert to numeric, and sum by area to get total acres burned per area per year

operatorProperties.code:
def process(combine_data):
    df = combine_data.copy()
    
    # Get all geographic areas (excluding Year and Total columns)
    areas = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['Year', 'Total']]
    
    # Melt the dataframe to have (Year, Area, Acres) format
    melted = df.melt(id_vars=['Year'], value_vars=areas, 
                     var_name='Area', value_name='Acres')
    
    # Convert Acres to numeric if not already
    melted['Acres'] = pd.to_numeric(melted['Acres'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Drop any NaN values
    melted = melted.dropna()
    
    return melted

operators.customDisplayName: Reshape combined data from wide format (areas as columns) to long format (Area, Year, Acres); exclude Year and Total columns; convert Acres to numeric and drop nulls

def process(prepare_analysis) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = prepare_analysis.groupby('Area')['Acres'].mean().reset_index()
    df.columns = ['Area', 'Mean_Acres']
    return df

operators.customDisplayName: Calculate historical mean acres burned per geographic area across all years in dataset

operatorProperties.code:
def process(prepare_analysis) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = prepare_analysis.groupby('Area')['Acres'].std().reset_index()
    df.columns = ['Area', 'Std_Acres']
    return df

operators.customDisplayName: Calculate historical standard deviation of acres burned per geographic area across all years

operatorProperties.code:
def process(prepare_analysis, calculate_mean_acres, calculate_std_acres):
    data = prepare_analysis.copy()
    means = calculate_mean_acres.set_index('Area')['Mean_Acres']
    stds = calculate_std_acres.set_index('Area')['Std_Acres']
    
    data['Mean'] = data['Area'].map(means)
    data['Std'] = data['Area'].map(stds)
    data['ZScore'] = (data['Acres'] - data['Mean']) / data['Std']
    
    return data[['Year', 'Area', 'Acres', 'Mean', 'Std', 'ZScore']]

operators.customDisplayName: Calculate Z-score for each year-area combination as (Acres - Historical_Mean) / Historical_Std

operatorProperties.code:
def process(calculate_zscore) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = calculate_zscore.copy()
    df['AbsZScore'] = df['ZScore'].abs()
    max_idx = df['AbsZScore'].idxmax()
    result = df.loc[[max_idx], ['Area', 'Year', 'ZScore', 'AbsZScore', 'Acres', 'Mean', 'Std']]
    return result

operators.customDisplayName: Find the year-area combination with the maximum absolute Z-score (most anomalous); return the area, year, and Z-score statistics

operatorProperties.code:
def process(find_max_anomaly):
    result = find_max_anomaly.copy()
    area = result['Area'].iloc[0]
    year = int(result['Year'].iloc[0])
    zscore = result['ZScore'].iloc[0]
    
    return pd.DataFrame({
        'Geographic_Area': [area],
        'Year': [year],
        'ZScore': [zscore],
        'Answer': [f"{area},{year}"]
    })
